premise: Snail sets out for Mushroom beyond the old log; Ladybug flies ahead and back three times asking if he is nearly there; Snail arrives at sunset and Mushroom has waited.
inspiration: The Tortoise and the Hare (Aesop), turned: nobody races, nobody naps; the slow journey is the adventure and the finish line has been waiting all along.
lesson: Going slowly still gets you there, and the going is the good part.

en-US.title: Snail's Grand Expedition
en-US.text: On the far side of the old log lived Mushroom, small and white and quiet. Snail looked at the log. It was very big. Today, said Snail, I am going on a grand expedition. And off he went. Slide. Slide. Slide. Ladybug {ladybug:hop} zipped over. Nearly there? she asked. Not yet, said Snail. Slide. Slide. Ladybug {ladybug:float x2} flew to the top of the log and back. Nearly there? Not yet. Slide. Slide. Slide. The sun moved across the sky. Ladybug {ladybug:spin} looped the loop and came back. Now? Now, said Snail. And there was Mushroom, {mushroom:pulse} {mushroom:glow} pink in the sunset, exactly where she had always been. You came, said Mushroom. I said I would, said Snail. Ladybug sat down beside them, and the three of them watched the sun go home. Slowly. The best way.

es-ES.title: La gran expedición de Caracol
es-ES.text: Al otro lado del tronco viejo vivía Seta, pequeña, blanca y callada. Caracol miró el tronco. Era muy grande. Hoy, dijo Caracol, me voy de gran expedición. Y allá se fue. Ris. Ras. Ris. Mariquita {ladybug:hop} llegó volando. ¿Ya casi? preguntó. Todavía no, dijo Caracol. Ris. Ras. Mariquita {ladybug:float x2} voló hasta lo alto del tronco y volvió. ¿Ya casi? Todavía no. Ris. Ras. Ris. El sol cruzó el cielo despacio. Mariquita {ladybug:spin} hizo una pirueta en el aire y volvió otra vez. ¿Y ahora? Ahora, dijo Caracol. Y allí estaba Seta, {mushroom:pulse} {mushroom:glow} rosada con la luz del atardecer, justo donde había estado siempre. Has venido, dijo Seta. Dije que vendría, dijo Caracol. Mariquita se sentó a su lado, y los tres vieron cómo el sol se iba a casa. Despacito. Que es la mejor manera.

sound.note: a soft, slow slither, three times
